question: Does Real Music apply its Redirect Skill damage bonus by delivered packet category independently of input role?
decision: Interpret native DamageSourceCategory E as Redirect Skill damage, following the existing Paper Plane model. Add exact T1-T5 ratios in the additive damage-bonus zone for every wearer E packet, including delayed off-field packets. Unknown or missing categories fail. The effect is permanent with no trigger or expiry.
availability: Frozen Global release availability remains unverified.
stop_condition: Check T1-T5 curves and units, legal equipped build, independent damage arithmetic, native primary/child packets, off-field ownership and CLI/WASM/Worker parity.
return_condition: New packet classification, release or damage-zone evidence conflicts with the model.
checks: 159 content tests pass: exact T1-T5 ratios, changed-parameter/unit rejection and a legal Mint/Real Music native build. Independent exact additive damage multiplier agrees with execution.

Independent category oracle: 1000 ATK * .5 DEF * (1 + .1 general + .12 weapon) = 610 for E packets in Nature/Cosmos/physical tests; every other recognized category remains 550. Delayed Skill delivery after switching remains wearer-only. Duplicate/mismatched gear and missing/unknown packet categories fail.

Public Mint A0 level 80 talents 8/8/8 equipped Real Music T1-T5: only Skill receives the independently calculated damage bonus. Iroi A0 T5 checks the primary and both native Skill child packets. Full CLI/WASM report parity passes for all six scripts; the real Worker Iroi script agrees with direct WASM. Native parity is scoped with NTESIM_VERIFY_NATIVE=1 NTESIM_VERIFY_WEAPON=appliance; other weapons retain WASM/Worker checks.

TypeScript and production build, native_build and scenario_script test modules pass. Changed Rust files pass rustfmt. Content clippy passes allowing only the two pre-existing metadata lints collapsible_if and single_element_loop. Kits and timing remain partial; frozen source bytes are unchanged.
